_readme: Etsy launch kit data. Edit here, then: node _tools/build-etsy-kit.js --write (text) and --images (renders listing images and Start Here PDFs to _content/etsy/out/, gitignored). Prices are NOT stored: each listing reads its product page's own itemprop price, so Etsy and the site quote one figure. Customer-facing: no em-dashes, and the tool refuses one.

shop.title: Music bingo and trivia nights that bring people together
shop.announcement: We have been hosting music bingo and trivia nights on live crowds since 1999, and every game here is one we would run ourselves. Everything is an instant digital download: print the cards, press play on the playlist, and you are hosting tonight. Questions about a game? Send us a message, we answer every one.
shop.about_story:
My first shows were in 1999, hosting "Name That Tune" in Calgary. More than twenty-five years of standing in front of rooms later, the job is still the same: unite an audience and break down the walls people walk in with.

We are entertainers. We are ice-breakers. Times are hard for a lot of people, and a game night is one of the few places left where strangers sit at the same table, laugh at the same wrong answer and leave knowing each other's names. That is why we do this.

Every game in this shop got tried out on a live crowd first, which is why the questions land, why the rounds are the length they are, and why the songs are ones people actually shout along to. We hand you the night, tested and ready, so you can be the one who brings your people together.

What we believe: a room full of strangers is one good game away from being a crowd. Everyone gets to play, and nobody should leave a game night feeling stupid. Phones down, heads up. And the host is the hero: our job is to make you look great.

Questions, or a night we have not covered yet? Send me a message. I read them all.

Dusty Ramsbottom, Entertainer and Founder

policies.digital_downloads: This is a digital download. Nothing is shipped. Your files are ready on the Etsy Purchases page the moment payment clears, and Etsy emails you a link too.
policies.returns: Because digital files cannot be returned, Etsy does not offer automatic returns on them. We still stand behind every game: if a file will not open, prints wrong, or the game is not what the listing described, message us and we will fix it, replace it, or refund you.
policies.exchanges: Bought one game and want the pack? Message us within 30 days with your order number and we will credit what you paid toward a larger pack in this shop.
faq: What do I need to host?

A printer, a pen for each player and a way to play music out loud. The playlists are on Spotify and Apple Music, and the callsheet lists every song in play order if you would rather use your own music.
What paper size are the cards?
They are made for US Letter paper, printed landscape. On A4, choose "Fit to page" when you print.
Each game has 250 different cards, so up to 250 players, each with a unique card.
Can I use these at a paid event or a bar?
Yes. Host as many nights as you like, at home, at work or at your venue. Please do not resell or share the files themselves.
Do I need a screen or software for the trivia nights?

No. The printable trivia nights are paper only: a host packet to read from, team answer sheets and a score sheet. The game show listings are the exception, they run in Microsoft PowerPoint on a TV or projector, and the listing says so.

shop.thank_you_message: Thank you for your order! Start with the file called START HERE: it has the playlist links for your game and the three steps to hosting. Print the cards landscape on Letter paper (on A4, choose "Fit to page"). If anything does not open or print right, message us and a real host will sort it out. Have a great night.
shop.about_links_note: Etsy allows a link to your own website on the shop About page only. Do not put the website, a discount code for it, or any "buy it cheaper on our site" line in a listing, a message or a file: Etsy treats steering a buyer off Etsy to buy as fee avoidance.

how_bingo: Print the cards (landscape) and hand one to each player.
Open the playlist from your START HERE file and press play. About 60 seconds of each song is plenty.
Players mark the song they hear. Call a line, four corners or a blackout, and keep the callsheet handy to check a winner.
how_trivia: Print the team answer sheets and the score sheet. Keep the host packet for yourself.
Read each round out loud. Teams write their answers and hand the sheet in.
Mark, read the scores, and use the tiebreaker if two tables finish level.
how_gameshow: Open the game in Microsoft PowerPoint on a TV or projector.
Teams pick a category and a value, and you reveal the question with a click.
Play the matching playlist between rounds and keep score on the board.
good_to_know: Instant digital download. Nothing is shipped.
Cards print on US Letter, landscape. On A4, choose "Fit to page".
Host it as many times as you like, at home, at work or at your venue.
If anything is not right, message us and we will fix it or refund you.
